1.english_reference: Moreover , when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ הַפִּֽילְ כֶ֨ם אֶת הָ אָ֜רֶץ בְּ נַחֲלָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῷ καταμετρεῖσθαι ὑμᾶς τὴν γῆν ἐν κληρονομίᾳ
traditions.VUL: Cumque cœpéritis terram divídere sortíto ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover , when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance ,

1.english_reference: ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD , an holy portion of the land :

traditions.WLC: תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַ יהוָ֥ה קֹדֶשׁ֮ מִן הָ אָרֶץ֒
traditions.LXX: ἀφοριεῖτε ἀπαρχὴν τῷ κυρίῳ ἅγιον ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: separáte primítias Dómino , sanctificátum de terra ,
traditions.KJV: ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD , an holy portion of the land :

1.english_reference: the length [ shall be ] the length of five and twenty thousand [ reeds ] , and the breadth [ shall be ] ten thousand .

traditions.WLC: אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְ רֹ֖חַב עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף
traditions.LXX: πέντε καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας μῆκος καὶ εὖρος εἴκοσι χιλιάδας ·
traditions.VUL: longitúdine vigínti quinque míllia , et latitúdine decem míllia :
traditions.KJV: the length [ shall be ] the length of five and twenty thousand [ reeds ] , and the breadth [ shall be ] ten thousand .

1.english_reference: This [ shall be ] holy in all the borders thereof round about .

traditions.WLC: קֹדֶשׁ ה֥וּא בְ כָל גְּבוּלָ֖ הּ סָבִֽיב
traditions.LXX: ἅγιον ἔσται ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτοῦ κυκλόθεν.
traditions.VUL: sanctificátum erit in omni término eius per circúitum .
traditions.KJV: This [ shall be ] holy in all the borders thereof round about .

2.english_reference: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred [ in length ] , with five hundred [ in breadth ] , square round about ;

traditions.WLC: יִהְיֶ֤ה מִ זֶּה֙ אֶל הַ קֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע סָבִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐκ τούτου ἁγιάσματα πεντακόσιοι ἐπὶ πεντακοσίους τετράγωνον κυκλόθεν ,
traditions.VUL: Et erit ex omni parte sanctificátum quingéntos per quingéntos , quadrifáriam per circúitum ,
traditions.KJV: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred [ in length ] , with five hundred [ in breadth ] , square round about ;

2.english_reference: and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof .

traditions.WLC: וַ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖ וֹ סָבִֽיב
traditions.LXX: καὶ πήχεις πεντήκοντα διάστημα αὐτῷ κυκλόθεν.
traditions.VUL: et quinquagínta cúbitis in suburbána eius per gyrum .
traditions.KJV: and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof .

3.english_reference: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand , and the breadth of ten thousand :

traditions.WLC: וּ מִן הַ מִּדָּ֤ה הַ זֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חמש וְ עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ רֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκ ταύτης τῆς διαμετρήσεως διαμετρήσεις μῆκος πέντε καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας καὶ εὖρος εἴκοσι χιλιάδας ,
traditions.VUL: Et a mensúra ista mensurábis longitúdinem vigínti quinque míllium , et latitúdinem decem míllium ,
traditions.KJV: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand , and the breadth of ten thousand :

3.english_reference: and in it shall be the sanctuary [ and ] the most holy [ place ] .

traditions.WLC: וּ בֽ וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָדָשִֽׁים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων.
traditions.VUL: et in ipso erit templum , sanctúmque sanctórum .
traditions.KJV: and in it shall be the sanctuary [ and ] the most holy [ place ] .

4.english_reference: The holy [ portion ] of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary ,

traditions.WLC: קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן הָ אָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַ כֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַ מִּקְדָּשׁ֙
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἔσται τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Sanctificátum de terra erit sacerdótibus minístris sanctuárii ,
traditions.KJV: The holy [ portion ] of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary ,

4.english_reference: which shall come near to minister unto the LORD :

traditions.WLC: יִֽהְיֶ֔ה הַ קְּרֵבִ֖ים לְ שָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται τοῖς ἐγγίζουσι λειτουργεῖν τῷ κυρίῳ ·
traditions.VUL: qui accédunt ad ministérium Dómini :
traditions.KJV: which shall come near to minister unto the LORD :

4.english_reference: and it shall be a place for their houses , and an holy place for the sanctuary .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֨ה לָ הֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לְ בָ֣תִּ֔ים וּ מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַ מִּקְדָּֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῖς τόπος εἰς οἴκους ἀφωρισμένους τῷ ἁγιασμῷ αὐτῶν,
traditions.VUL: et erit eis locus in domos , et in sanctuárium sanctitátis .
traditions.KJV: and it shall be a place for their houses , and an holy place for the sanctuary .

5.english_reference: And the five and twenty thousand of length , and the ten thousand of breadth , shall also the Levites , the ministers of the house , have for themselves , for a possession for twenty chambers .

traditions.WLC: וַ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַ עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב יהיה לַ לְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַ בַּ֧יִת לָ הֶ֛ם לַ אֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת
traditions.LXX: εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε χιλιάδας μῆκος , καὶ εὖρος εἴκοσι χιλιάδες · καὶ τοῖς Λευείταις τοῖς λειτουργοῦσιν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῖς εἰς κατάσχεσιν πόλεις τοῦ κατοικεῖν.
traditions.VUL: Vigínti quinque autem míllia longitúdinis , et decem míllia latitúdinis erunt Levítis , qui minístrant dómui : ipsi possidébunt vigínti gazophylácia .
traditions.KJV: And the five and twenty thousand of length , and the ten thousand of breadth , shall also the Levites , the ministers of the house , have for themselves , for a possession for twenty chambers .

6.english_reference: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad , and five and twenty thousand long ,

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָ עִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν κατάσχεσιν τῆς πόλεως δώσεις πέντε χιλιάδας εὖρος , καὶ μῆκος πέντε καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας ,
traditions.VUL: Et possessiónem civitátis dábitis quinque míllia latitúdinis , et longitúdinis vigínti quinque míllia ,
traditions.KJV: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad , and five and twenty thousand long ,

6.english_reference: over against the oblation of the holy [ portion ] :

traditions.WLC: לְ עֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ קֹּ֑דֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: ὃν τρόπον ἡ ἀπαρχὴ τῶν ἁγίων
traditions.VUL: secúndum separatiónem sanctuárii ,
traditions.KJV: over against the oblation of the holy [ portion ] :

6.english_reference: it shall be for the whole house of Israel .

traditions.WLC: לְ כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה
traditions.LXX: παντὶ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ ἔσονται.
traditions.VUL: omni dómui Israel .
traditions.KJV: it shall be for the whole house of Israel .

7.english_reference: And [ a portion shall be ] for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy [ portion ] , and of the possession of the city ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ נָּשִׂ֡יא מִ זֶּ֣ה וּ מִ זֶּה֩ לִ תְרוּמַ֨ת הַ קֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְ לַ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ עִ֗יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ ἡγουμένῳ ἐκ τούτου καὶ ἀπὸ τούτου εἰς τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν ἁγίων , εἰς κατάσχεσιν τῆς πόλεως ,
traditions.VUL: Príncipi quoque hinc et inde in separatiónem sanctuárii , et in possessiónem civitátis ,
traditions.KJV: And [ a portion shall be ] for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy [ portion ] , and of the possession of the city ,

7.english_reference: before the oblation of the holy [ portion ] , and before the possession of the city ,

traditions.WLC: אֶל פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת הַ קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ אֶל פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָ עִ֔יר
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἀπαρχῶν τῶν ἁγίων καὶ κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς κατασχέσεως τῆς πόλεως ,
traditions.VUL: contra fáciem separatiónis sanctuárii , et contra fáciem possessiónis urbis ,
traditions.KJV: before the oblation of the holy [ portion ] , and before the possession of the city ,

7.english_reference: from the west side westward , and from the east side eastward :

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּאַת יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּ ה וּ מִ פְּאַת קֵ֖דְמָ ה קָדִ֑ימָ ה
traditions.LXX: τὰ πρὸς θάλασσαν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πρὸς θάλασσαν πρὸς ἀνατολάς ·
traditions.VUL: a látere maris usque ad mare , et a látere oriéntis usque ad oriéntem :
traditions.KJV: from the west side westward , and from the east side eastward :

7.english_reference: and the length [ shall be ] over against one of the portions , from the west border unto the east border .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹ֗רֶךְ לְ עֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַ חֲלָקִ֔ים מִ גְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ μῆκος ὡς μία τῶν μερίδων ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων τῶν πρὸς θάλασσαν , καὶ τὸ μῆκος ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια τὰ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς τῆς γῆς.
traditions.VUL: longitúdinis autem iuxta unamquámque partem , a término occidentáli usque ad términum orientálem .
traditions.KJV: and the length [ shall be ] over against one of the portions , from the west border unto the east border .

8.english_reference: In the land shall be his possession in Israel :

traditions.WLC: לָ אָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה לּ֥ וֹ לַֽ אֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται αὐτῷ εἰς κατάσχεσιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: De terra erit ei posséssio in Israel ,
traditions.KJV: In the land shall be his possession in Israel :

8.english_reference: and my princes shall no more oppress my people ;

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא יוֹנ֨וּ ע֤וֹד נְשִׂיאַ י֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ καταδυναστεύσουσιν οὐκέτι οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ τὸν λαόν μου ·
traditions.VUL: et non depopulabúntur ultra príncipes pópulum meum :
traditions.KJV: and my princes shall no more oppress my people ;

8.english_reference: and [ the rest of ] the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְ בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ שִׁבְטֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν γῆν κατακληρονομήσουσιν οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ φυλὰς αὐτῶν.
traditions.VUL: sed terram dabunt dómui Israel secúndum tribus eórum .
traditions.KJV: and [ the rest of ] the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes .

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος θεός
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

9.english_reference: Let it suffice you , O princes of Israel :

traditions.WLC: רַב לָ כֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Ἱκανούσθω ὑμῖν , οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ·
traditions.VUL: Suffíciat vobis príncipes Israel :
traditions.KJV: Let it suffice you , O princes of Israel :

traditions.WLC: חָמָ֤ס וָ שֹׁד֙ הָסִ֔ירוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀδικίαν καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν ἀφέλεσθε ,
traditions.VUL: iniquitátem et rapínas intermíttite ,
traditions.KJV: remove violence and spoil ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ צְדָקָ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ
traditions.LXX: κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ποιήσατε ·
traditions.VUL: et iudícium et iustítiam fácite ,
traditions.KJV: and execute judgment and justice ,

9.english_reference: take away your exactions from my people , saith the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵי כֶם֙ מֵ עַ֣ל עַמִּ֔ י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐξάρατε καταδυναστείαν ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ μου , λέγει Κύριος θεός.
traditions.VUL: separáte confínia vestra a pópulo meo , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: take away your exactions from my people , saith the Lord GOD .

10.english_reference: Ye shall have just balances , and a just ephah , and a just bath .

traditions.WLC: מֹֽאזְנֵי צֶ֧דֶק וְ אֵֽיפַת צֶ֛דֶק וּ בַת צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ζυγὸς δίκαιος καὶ μέτρον δίκαιον καὶ χοῖνιξ δικαία ἔστω ὑμῖν τοῦ μέτρου,
traditions.VUL: Statéra iusta , et ephi iustum , et batus iustus erit vobis .
traditions.KJV: Ye shall have just balances , and a just ephah , and a just bath .

11.english_reference: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure ,

traditions.WLC: הָ אֵיפָ֣ה וְ הַ בַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ χοῖνιξ ὁμοίως μία ἔσται τοῦ λαμβάνειν ·
traditions.VUL: Ephi , et batus æquália , et uníus mensúræ erunt :
traditions.KJV: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure ,

11.english_reference: that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer ,

traditions.WLC: לָ שֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַ חֹ֖מֶר הַ בָּ֑ת
traditions.LXX: τὸ δέκατον τοῦ γόμορ χοῖνιξ ,
traditions.VUL: ut cápiat décimam partem cori batus ,
traditions.KJV: that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer ,

11.english_reference: and the ephah the tenth part of an homer :

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַ חֹ֨מֶר֙ הָֽ אֵיפָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ δέκατον τοῦ γόμορ ,
traditions.VUL: et décimam partem cori ephi :
traditions.KJV: and the ephah the tenth part of an homer :

11.english_reference: the measure thereof shall be after the homer .

traditions.WLC: אֶל הַ חֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: πρὸς τὸ γόμορ ἔσται τὸ ἴσον.
traditions.VUL: iuxta mensúram cori erit æqua librátio eórum .
traditions.KJV: the measure thereof shall be after the homer .

12.english_reference: And the shekel [ shall be ] twenty gerahs :

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ שֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ στάθμια εἴκοσι ὀβολοί ,
traditions.VUL: Siclus autem vigínti óbolos habet :
traditions.KJV: And the shekel [ shall be ] twenty gerahs :

traditions.WLC: עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים
traditions.LXX: πέντε σίκλοι ,
traditions.VUL: porro vigínti sicli ,
traditions.KJV: twenty shekels ,

traditions.WLC: חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: πέντε καὶ σίκλοι ,
traditions.VUL: et vigínti quinque sicli ,
traditions.KJV: five and twenty shekels ,

traditions.WLC: עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל
traditions.LXX: δέκα καὶ πεντήκοντα σίκλοι
traditions.VUL: quíndecim sicli ,
traditions.KJV: fifteen shekels ,

traditions.WLC: הַ מָּנֶ֖ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἡ μνᾶ ἔσται ὑμῖν.
traditions.VUL: mnam fáciunt .
traditions.KJV: shall be your maneh .

13.english_reference: This [ is ] the oblation that ye shall offer ;

traditions.WLC: זֹ֥את הַ תְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὕτη ἡ ἀπαρχὴ ἣν ἀφοριεῖτε ,
traditions.VUL: Et hæ sunt sunt primítiæ , quas tollétis :
traditions.KJV: This [ is ] the oblation that ye shall offer ;

13.english_reference: the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat ,

traditions.WLC: שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָֽ אֵיפָה֙ מֵ חֹ֣מֶר הַֽ חִטִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ἕκτον μέτρον ἀπὸ τοῦ γόμορ τοῦ πυροῦ ,
traditions.VUL: sextam partem ephi de coro fruménti ,
traditions.KJV: the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat ,

13.english_reference: and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley :

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָֽ אֵיפָ֔ה מֵ חֹ֖מֶר הַ שְּׂעֹרִֽים
